name: start_perfetto_capture
description: Start a background Perfetto capture on a connected Meta Quest device. The capture runs indefinitely until stopped with stop_perfetto_capture. Use for manual start/stop workflows where you want to capture a specific interaction. Returns a PID and output_name that must be passed to stop_perfetto_capture.

app.description: App package name to trace. If not specified, auto-detects.

cpu_scheduling.description: Enable CPU scheduling tracing. Only with mode 'custom'.

extended_scheduling.description: Enable extended scheduling events. Only with mode 'custom'.

gpu_metrics.description: Enable GPU metrics tracing. Only with mode 'custom'.

gpu_render_stage.description: Enable GPU render stage tracing. Only with mode 'custom'.

output_name.description: Output filename (without extension). If not specified, auto-generated.

vulkan_layer.description: Enable Vulkan OS layer tracing. Only with mode 'custom'.

xr_runtime.description: Enable XR runtime metrics. Only with mode 'custom'.
